info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Wholesale Trading By Param1-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Update API allows for the modification of dealer desk parameters in the wholesale trading domain. This API enables users to make targeted updates to trading parameters identified by unique identifiers, facilitating efficient management of trading operations. Typically utilized by financial institutions, brokers, and trading platforms, this API supports cases where dynamic adjustments to trading strategies are necessary. It ensures that the dealer desk can adapt promptly to changing market conditions and operational requirements.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specified dealer desk resource. Users can modify various attributes of the resource to ensure they are current and accurate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the dealer desk information for a specific wholesale trading resource identified by RES-100045. The request payload must conform to the defined schema to ensure data integrity and consistency.

200.description: Request processed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
